第一千一百零五章 神性源泉干涸（第1页）
神性源泉干涸（神性源泉干涸（第22页）这时，武书看似从容淡定，内心却也是波澜壮阔的。刚刚那是什么情况？在承受鼠标一拳后，武书也是出现了气血上头的感觉，一个念头也是从武书的脑海中一闪而过，肋骨之仇必须报。然后，武书便进入了空灵状态，似是……空域体承载着雷域将神级战技天雷万牢引凝炼出来。再然后，手起手落，直至一掌落下，武书才意识到自己的不对劲，将大部分力量收了回来。“掌中世界？？！！”在将这四个字说出来时，那一瞬的感觉，在武书的神识空间内反复出现，以至于神性源泉直接干涸了。“有没有搞错？”“到底是什么情况？”“体法双修？”……当前汇聚在苍源域内的小辈天骄，随便拉一个出来都是拥有某一种先天战体的，这些天骄会对武书佩服，正因武书将炼体之路拓宽了。当有人将体法双修四个字说出来时，不少天骄也是出现了心灰意冷的感觉。非厚土大陆，自先天战体被发现的那一刻，很多小辈天骄便要终日承受法修同辈的冷眼相迎。正因战体这条路是一条断头路，不兼修其他道途根本成长不起来。或许……先天战体前期十分能打，可是随着岁月的推移，各种战体终将落于下乘。“说来也是有趣！”以武书当前的状态，十里道台周边的风吹草动都是会被武书听到的。而在听出很多天骄的复杂情绪后，武书依旧如实道，“或许是因为空域体的缘故，又或许是因为本少主的炼体境界已经达到三次悟道境，再次动用秘法秘技力量，这股力量便是自然而然地出现。”自然而然四个字一出，强如朝刹等都是精神抖擞起来。“当然，不论这种力量是属于炼体力量还是属于法修绝技，能够在当前实力境界将其施展出来，皆是因为本少主的空域体、雷雨血脉跟形态足够强大。”有了武书的这些话后，鼠标是更加疯狂了。“哈哈哈……！”倘若说，武书战斗到兴奋时，喜欢将上身袍子扯掉，算是暴露狂。那么，鼠标战斗到兴奋时，直接将胸前皮毛一把撕开，任血淋淋的血肉敞亮开，鼠标肯定算自虐狂。“终于……终于……遇到一个能够让本王彻底疯狂的对手了。”那一刻，鼠标胸膛一片肉红，大量黑色瘴气不断自其双瞳中散发出来。与此同时，一枚枚妖族文字在穷奇擂台上若隐若现，妖族文字范围武书所能爆发出的战力将会被压制掉至少三成。“二变魂技，地煞！”当鼠标将二变魂技地煞的名字爆出来时，问道城内的很多天骄无不是感觉，是不是要天塌了。大道兵器乌青炉在不断发出强烈的抖动声，肉眼可见的涟漪不断以鼠标为中心散发出来。“将穷奇符文与悟道石力形态配合起来施展，果真好用。”或许是因为此次出手借用了悟道石力形态，鼠标也不清楚接下来的出手能够爆发出何等惊世骇俗的力量，再次向武书前，其也是不忘提醒武书一句。

Chapter 1,105 The source of divinity dries up (page 1)
The source of divinity dries up (The source of divinity dries up (page 22)) At this time, Wu Shu seemed calm and calm, but his heart was also full of excitement. What happened just now? After receiving a punch from the mouse, Wu Shu also felt a surge of energy and blood, and a thought flashed through Wu Shu's mind. The revenge of the ribs must be avenged. Then, Wu Shu entered an ethereal state, as if... The air domain body carries the god-level combat skills of the generals in the thunder field. Lei Wanlao Yin condensed it. Then, he raised his hands and fell, and Wu Shu realized that something was wrong with him and took back most of his power. "The world in the palm of your hand??!!" When he said these four words, the feeling of that moment appeared repeatedly in Wu Shu's consciousness space, so that the source of divinity dried up directly. "Is there any mistake?" "What is going on?" "Physical and physical cultivation?"... Any of the junior prodigies gathered in the Cangyuan Territory would have a certain kind of innate combat body. These prodigies would admire martial arts, because Wu Shu has broadened the path to physical training, and many prodigies also felt discouraged. In the non-Huntu Continent, from the moment the innate combat body was discovered, many junior prodigies have to endure the cold shoulder of their fellow practitioners all day long. The body path is a dead end, and it is impossible to grow without practicing other paths. Maybe... the innate combat body is very capable in the early stage, but as time goes by, all kinds of combat bodies will eventually fall behind. "It's interesting to say!" With Wu Shu's current state, Wu Shu will hear all the disturbances around Shili Daotai. After hearing the complicated emotions of many geniuses, Wu Shu still said truthfully, "Maybe it's because of the air domain body. The reason, or maybe it's because this young master's body refining realm has reached the realm of enlightenment three times, and when he uses the power of secret techniques again, this power appears naturally. "Naturally, as soon as these four words came out, Qiang Ru Chaosha and others became energetic. "Of course, whether this kind of power belongs to the body refining power or the magic cultivation skill, it is possible to display it at the current level of strength because of this young master's air domain body and thunder rain. The bloodline and form are strong enough." After Wu Shu said these words, Mouse became even more crazy. "Hahaha...!" If Wu Shu likes to tear off his upper body robe when he is excited about fighting, he is considered an exhibitionist. Then, when Mouse is excited about fighting, he just tears open the fur on his chest and exposes the bloody flesh. "Finally... finally... I met someone who can make me completely crazy. At that moment, Mouse's chest turned red, and a large amount of black miasma continued to emit from his pupils. At the same time, monster characters loomed on the Qiongqi Arena, and the combat power that could be unleashed by the martial arts within the scope of the monster characters would be suppressed by at least 30%. "Second Transformation Soul Skill, Earth Demon!" When Mouse revealed the name of the Second Transformation Soul Skill, Earth Demon, many geniuses in the city felt that they were going to The sky is falling. The avenue weapon Wuqing Furnace is making a strong shaking sound, and ripples visible to the naked eye are constantly emanating from the mouse. "It is really easy to use the Qiongqi Rune and the Enlightenment Stone Power form." Perhaps because this move borrowed the Enlightenment Stone Power form, the mouse did not know what kind of shocking power the next move could unleash. He did not forget to remind Wu Shu again.
